FX.title: [USD/JPY] DOWN: Price below MA20 and mixed fundamentals point to JPY strength
tldr_points: Current price 157.80 below 20‑MA 157.93, indicating short‑term bearish bias.
Mixed US macro data (construction slump, slowing PMIs) weigh on USD.
Risk‑off sentiment and neutral RSI suggest limited upside, favouring short USD/JPY.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY trades below its 20‑MA amid mixed US macro data; bearish bias emerges for near‑term.
FX.comment: 価格が20MAを下回り、建設支出やPMIの弱含みからドル賣りが優勢；短期的な下落基調を維持。
